method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using Rogue River near Rockford, MI USGS 04118500 daily mean discharge, no measured-temperature score; the configured temperature weight is zero because no multi-season daily record passed replay, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to This Limited read combines measured Packer Drive discharge with modeled light and precipitation for the lower Rogue only. It does not directly describe the middle reach, Rockford tailwater, clarity, temperature, fish passage, abundance, access, or safety. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
